notes.text:
Fourth press, 4089 copies made according to label page.

Cat.number RR7311 on sleeve, cat.number RR50791 on hype sticker.

Comes in a gatefold sleeve with extended printed lyrics and insert notes.

All matrix/runout stamped, except (A - PENTAGRAM) etched.

Tracks A5, B5 recorded at The Fireplace 7/6/72.
Tracks A1, A2, A3, A6, B4 recorded at Bias Recording Studios, Falls Church, VA 3/22/73. 
Track B1 recorded at Bias Recording Studios, Falls Church, VA 6/13/73. 
Tracks B2, B3 recorded live at National Sound Warehouse, Springfield, VA 6/5/74 & 6/14/74. 
Track B6 recorded live at the rehearsal warehouse, summer '74. 
Track A4 recorded at Underground Sound, Largo, MD 9/4,12 & 23/76.
